verdict.rationale: Docs clearly document scheduled task automation ("Automations let you schedule prompts to run automatically at recurring times", running test suites daily and reporting failures) plus autonomous agent execution with tool approvals, sub-agent delegation, and notifications when long-running background tasks complete, showing this runs independent of active user interaction. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on verification that scheduled automations reliably execute unattended over time, and more detail on reliability/error-handling in production.
